blocks.text: "Bowers & Wilkins Px8 S2 for Ultimate Audio Listening ExperienceThe Px8 S2 over-ear noise-canceling headphones from Bowers & Wilkins are designed for audiophiles and discerning listeners who prioritize sound quality. Custom 40mm Carbon Cone drive units, powered by a high-performance 24-bit DSP, dedicated amplification, and an integrated DAC, deliver clear, high-resolution audio with impressive detail, balance, and depth.Crafted from soft Nappa leather and solid die-cast aluminum, its sleeker silhouette over the original Px8 offers lasting comfort for frequent flyers, extended listening, remote working on computer, or long gaming sessions on PS5 or Xbox. Active Noise Cancellation, supported by eight microphones, helps adapt ambient noise while preserving hi-res audio fidelity. ADI Pure Voice technology enhances call clarity in busy environments. Whether you're on a business call or catching up on the go, Px8 S2 delivers uncompromising performance, so you never miss a moment.Bluetooth 5.3 with aptX Lossless, Adaptive, HD, Classic, AAC, and SBC supports high-quality wireless streaming. A rechargeable lithium-ion battery provides up to 30 hours playback, with a 15-minute fast charge delivering up to 7 hours. Through the Bowers & Wilkins Music app, users can fine-tune sound with a five-band EQ, True Sound mode, and customizable noise cancellation controls."

items.label: HEAR MUSIC THE WAY THE ARTIST INTENDED
items.value: Designed for listeners who prioritize audio fidelity above all, Px8 S2 over-ear headphones give you reference quality sound. Custom 40mm Carbon Cone drivers, 24-bit DSP, and a dedicated DAC amplifier deliver a detailed soundstage with balanced bass and lifelike clarity. All from a sleeker headphone silhouette

items.label: SOLID BUILD FOR STABILITY AND COMFORT
items.value: Precision-engineered with solid die-cast aluminum arms and soft Nappa leather, this wireless headset delivers immersive sound with all-day wearability for extended hours at work, for gaming, or travel. Unlike typical plastic alternatives, the design provides durability while maintaining acoustic performance

items.label: BALANCED ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION WITH PURE SOUND
items.value: Px8 S2 features an advanced 8-microphone system that monitors ambient noise and driver output. These over-ear noise cancelling headphones help reduce distractions during calls at home or in public while preserving the natural detail, depth, and balance of high-resolution audio

items.label: SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITY ACROSS DEVICES
items.value: Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint connectivity lets you connect to two devices at once and switch easily between phone, laptop, or tablet. Support for aptX Lossless and Adaptive enables hi-res wireless streaming, while USB-C audio and the included 3.5 mm cable support wired listening for gaming, movies and podcasts

items.label: POWER THAT LASTS THROUGH YOUR DAY
items.value: This Bluetooth headset delivers up to 30 hours of wireless playback to keep music and calls going from the home, office to long flights. A 15-minute fast charge provides up to 7 hours of listening, and the rechargeable lithium-ion battery fully recharges in about two hours. Includes a carry case for easy storage

items.label: PERSONALIZE YOUR LISTENING WITH THE B&W MUSIC APP
items.value: Enjoy great sound straight out of the box, or use the Bowers & Wilkins Music app to fine-tune settings with a 5-band EQ and True Sound mode tuned by B&W acoustic engineers. Adjust noise cancellation, transparency, and wear detection for a listening experience tailored to you

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: 1.2m USB-C to 3.5mm stereo jack audio cable, 1.2m USB-C to USB-C cable, Literature pack, Protective Case
